method: Native HSPRS/HSRAO complex fields and verified panel-following pressure; HSprv geometry/motion archived; ParaView command rendering

definitions.scattered: component 8 minus component 7; diffraction plus radiation
definitions.pressure: Native body-following first-order pressure perturbation at the mean wet panels, kPa; equilibrium hydrostatic pressure stored separately
definitions.motion: Native deformation vector; compared with the actual six-DOF complex response
definitions.surface_z: Native VTS coordinates already contain total elevation; derived views replace z before applying the display gain

component_basis: HydroStar Hstar2Paraview old-format component 8 and the native field decomposition; incident solution, total closure and motion independently checked
pressure_precision_basis: HSprv ASCII pressure has four significant digits; the harmonic residual bound is half the largest decimal quantization step times (1 + the infinity norm of the harmonic least-squares projection)
masking: Exclude cells intersecting a solved waterline footprint; preserve water between separate columns
time: Exact frame index times PRV TSTP; PVD timestamps are rounded by the native writer; duplicate endpoint excluded
accepted_display_fields: waves.json plus the explicitly linked pressure file; raw HSprv total and nodal pressure are retained as diagnostics

hsprv_crosscheck.finding: Old-format HSprv motion-induced wave reconstruction differs from independently extracted full-complex HSPRS fields; displayed total, scattered and radiation use HSPRS
